major_concerns: Synthetic corpus may under-represent vendor runtime semantics leading to optimistic verifier coverage.
Automated verifier false negatives could mask residual semantic errors.
LLM repair iterations may introduce new undetected semantic errors (hallucinations).
Ground-truth for semantic correctness may be underspecified.
required_design_repairs: Demonstrate verifier coverage and false-negative rate (via emulator or oracle subset) before claiming reduction magnitudes.
Include emulated/device-accurate execution (or clearly justify digital-twin fidelity) for a stratified subset.
Specify power analysis/sample-size targets and concrete thresholds for semantic-error reduction.
Document vendor templates and parsing pipeline; include tests for vendor-syntax corner cases.

major_concerns: Simulation fidelity: outage-proxy may not reflect real outage causality.
High-dimensional policy space risks sparse sampling and overfitting to simulator specifics.
Reliance on verifier-severity calibration assumes score correlates with real outage risk.
required_design_repairs: Adopt an efficient experimental-design (e.g., fractional factorial or Bayesian optimization) to budget policy sampling.
Validate simulator harm proxies against emulator-verified cases for a representative subset.
Pre-register exact policy-grid, sampling plan, and decision thresholds for Pareto claims.
Specify robustness/sensitivity checks under varied fault-injection regimes.

major_concerns: Accessing accurate vendor semantics and creating fair adapters is challenging and may bias results.
Manual ground-truth labeling limits scale and introduces annotation error.
Emulator verification may be partial, reducing confidence in measured recall losses.
required_design_repairs: Justify and document chosen vendors; publish adapter code and transformation rules for auditability.
Use dual-annotator labeling with inter-annotator agreement reporting and resolve disagreements transparently.
Where possible, expand emulator-verified ground truth coverage and report emulator limitations.
Pre-register sampling and adapter-development procedures to avoid post-hoc tuning.

major_concerns: Predictive link between audit metrics and simulated harm depends on fidelity of harm proxies.
Perturbation choices (types, magnitudes) may be seen as arbitrary without justification.
Benchmark/task-bank representativeness to production workloads is uncertain.
required_design_repairs: Define and justify a standardized perturbation taxonomy with intensity levels and provide reproducible generators.
Validate harm-proxy mapping against emulator-verified outcomes for a seed subset.
Pre-register models and thresholds used to map audit metrics to harm predictions and report sensitivity analyses.
Publish audit tooling and scripts to enable independent reproduction of fragility scores.
